_comment: Regression eval gold-set for /agent-team:eval. Each case runs through the gated pipeline against its target, then its `check` shell command scores it. Resolve the plan with `python3 evals/resolve_cases.py`. THIS SHIPS EMPTY: the bundled sample it used to test was retired, and a gold set for a project we have never seen cannot be written for you. `_example_case` below is kept as documentation of the shape — the resolver ignores keys starting with an underscore.
_targets: Copy `_example_case` into `cases`, set `target` + `requires` to your project directory (the name you gave /add-project), and write a `check` that FAILS before the work and PASSES after. A check that passes either way scores nothing.

_example_case.prompt: Add a truncate(text, length, suffix='...') helper: shorten text to at most `length` chars total, appending suffix only when it cuts. Add tests.
_example_case.check: python3 -c "from yourpkg import truncate; assert truncate('hello world', 8) == 'hello...'" && python3 -m pytest -q
